title: Krumpin'
subtitle: Fight phase: pile in, pick a weapon, swing, take it back

bullets: Da Fight phase opens wiv [b]Pile In[/b] — pick a unit, shuffle every model up to 3" closer, den [b]Confirm Move[/b]. Only models wivin 2" of da enemy get to swing, so dis is how ya get da back rank into da scrap. [b]End Pile In[/b] passes yer half.
Click a unit in [b]UNITS THAT CAN FIGHT[/b] to activate it. Units dat charged swing first — [b]all[/b] of 'em, before da enemy gets a look in.
A Warboss leadin' a mob is [b]part of dat mob[/b] — one row, [b]Boyz + Warboss[/b], an' dey krump in da [b]same[/b] activation. He don't get a swing of his own.
In da attack panel each [b]group[/b] of models picks its own weapon an' target — da mob's choppas, da Nob's big choppa an' da [b]Warboss's Power klaw[/b], all in da one panel. Den [b]Fight![/b]
Da dice dock rolls it out — [b]Fast Roll ⏩[/b] does da lot, [b]Done ✔[/b] finishes da activation.
Den da enemy activates an' da dock rolls [b]deir[/b] hits an' wounds at ya — you roll da saves an' can spend a [b]Command Re-roll[/b].
You an' da enemy alternate activations till everyone's swung. Last lesson: Runnin' da Show.

prompt.text: Da Boyz an' da Warboss made it in — now dey get to krump. Da boss is [b]leadin'[/b] dat mob, so dey're [b]one unit[/b]: one row in da list, one activation, an' dey all swing togevver. Every engaged unit fights once, an' units dat [b]charged[/b] all go before da enemy does. It starts wiv a [b]Pile In[/b] step.

prompt.kbm: Only models wivin 2" of da enemy can swing — an' five of yer boyz are stuck at da back. Click da [b]Boyz + Warboss[/b] row to start deir 3" pile in.
prompt.pad: Only models wivin 2" of da enemy can swing, an' five boyz are stuck at da back. {dpad} ▼ walks onto da [b]Boyz + Warboss[/b] row — den {a}.

blocked_hint.kbm: not yet — five of yer boyz can't reach da Custodes. Click da "Boyz + Warboss" row an' pile 'em in first.
blocked_hint.pad: not yet — five of yer boyz can't reach da Custodes. Put da {dpad} on da "Boyz + Warboss" row, press {a}, an' pile 'em in first.

hint.text: Da row is in da PILE IN STEP panel on da right. End Pile In would pass yer half wivout movin' anyone — dat's da one we ain't usin' yet.

prompt.kbm: Drag each back-rank boy up to 3" toward da Custodes — or hit [b]Auto Pile In[/b] an' let da computer do it. Den [b]Confirm Move[/b].
prompt.pad: Point wiv {ls} an' hold {a} to drag a boy, or glide onto [b]Auto Pile In[/b] an' press {a} for da lot. Den [b]Confirm Move[/b].

hint.text: Green arrow = legal, red = not closer or too far. Da five up front show a red B2B — dey're already touchin' an' can't budge. Only da back rank has anywhere to go.

prompt.kbm: Click [b]Boyz + Warboss[/b] under UNITS THAT CAN FIGHT — one row, 'cos da boss leads dat mob an' dey fight as one unit. Dey charged, so dey swing before da Custodes do.
prompt.pad: {dpad} ▼ walks da fight panel onto da [b]Boyz + Warboss[/b] row — {a} presses it. One row, 'cos da boss leads dat mob. Dey charged, so dey swing first.

hint.text: Da list only shows units in engagement range — dat's who can fight. Da Warboss ain't listed on his own: he's part of da Boyz now.

prompt.kbm: Each group of models fights wiv [b]one[/b] melee weapon. Pick a weapon for each group, pick da target, den [b]Fight![/b] Da boss has his own row — his Power klaw swings in dis same activation.
prompt.pad: Da attack panel takes its own controls: {dpad} ▲▼ picks da weapon in da lit-up section, ◀▶ picks da target, LB/RB hops between da [b]Boss Nob[/b] an' [b]Boy[/b] sections, den {menu} for [b]Fight![/b] Picked da wrong mob? {b} backs out to da unit list.

rewind_when.comment: The player backed out of the attack panel (CANCEL_FIGHTER_SELECTION). No unit is activated, no dialog is up and the picker is back on screen — so this card's 'pick a weapon' instructions describe a panel that is gone. Walk the lesson back to the fighter pick instead of stranding them.

hint.text: Da panel splits da unit by what it carries — [b]Boy[/b], [b]Boss Nob[/b] an' [b]Warboss[/b] each get deir own section, 'cos dey're all one unit now.

prompt.kbm: Same dice dock as shootin': [b]Fast Roll ⏩[/b] rolls hits, wounds an' saves in one go (or step frough wiv da big button) — for da mob's choppas [b]an'[/b] da boss's klaw, 'cos it's all one activation. Finish wiv [b]Done ✔[/b].
prompt.pad: Da dock starts on [b]Roll to Wound ▶[/b] — {dpad} ▼ drops onto [b]Fast Roll ⏩[/b], den {a}. Clear any save cards, den [b]Done ✔[/b].

hint.text: Da big dock button always says what's next — keep pressin' it till it says Done. One activation covers da whole unit, boss an' all.

prompt.kbm: Yer mob has swung — boss an' all, in da one activation — so it's da Custodes' turn. Dat's alternatin' activation. Da dock rolls [b]deir[/b] hits an' wounds; step frough it, den [b]Roll Saves[/b] on da card an' spend a [b]Command Re-roll[/b] if a save lets ya down.
prompt.pad: Da Custodes swing back now. Step frough deir rolls on da dock wiv {a}. Da save card takes da {dpad} on its own an' already sits on [b]Roll Saves[/b] — just press {a}.

hint.text: Ya can't re-roll deir dice — but da saves are yours, an' so's da Command Re-roll on 'em.

prompt.kbm: Everyone dat could swing has swung, so da phase is done — hit da big red button to end it.
prompt.pad: Everyone's swung, so da phase is done — press {menu} to end it.
